About Us

Precision, Innovation, Reliability

Welcome to Rotozest, a leading manufacturer and supplier of high-quality rotary gear pumps. With a strong reputation for excellence, we specialize in providing Cast Iron (CI) and Stainless Steel (SS) rotary gear pumps that cater to a wide range of industries, ensuring efficient and durable pumping solutions. Driven by innovation and expertise, our company is led by visionary owners Hitesh Bhai Patel, and Bharat Patel, whose leadership has positioned Rotozest as a trusted name in the market.

Our Expertise

Rotozest has become synonymous with excellence in rotary gear pumps. Our team of skilled engineers and technicians works tirelessly to design and manufacture pumps that meet the demanding requirements of industries such as oil and gas, chemical processing, food and beverage, agriculture, pharmaceuticals, and more.

With our Cast Iron and Stainless Steel rotary gear pumps, we offer robust and reliable solutions for transferring viscous fluids, oils, chemicals, and other materials. Every pump we produce is engineered for longevity, efficiency, and minimal maintenance.

Vision

At Rotozest, our vision is to become a global leader in the rotary gear pump industry, renowned for our innovative solutions and commitment to quality. We aim to set the standard for excellence by continually improving our products and services, ensuring that our customers experience superior performance and reliability in every application.

Mission

Our mission is to deliver high-quality rotary gear pumps that meet the specific needs of our customers across various industries. We are dedicated to providing efficient, durable, and cost-effective solutions that enhance productivity and operational efficiency. Through innovation, continuous improvement, and customer-centric service, we strive to exceed expectations and maintain our leadership in the market.

Our Core Value

Quality First

We are committed to producing top-tier rotary gear pumps through stringent quality control processes, ensuring every product meets the highest industry standards.

Innovation

We believe in staying ahead of the curve by embracing the latest technologies and continuously innovating to improve our products and processes.

Customer Focus

Our customers are our priority. We listen closely to their needs and deliver customized solutions that ensure maximum satisfaction and long-term relationships.

Integrity

We operate with transparency and honesty in all our business dealings, building trust with our clients, partners, and team members.

Sustainability

We are dedicated to manufacturing environmentally responsible products that reduce energy consumption and promote sustainability.

Why Choose Rotozest?

Innovation & Expertise

With experienced engineers, we innovate to deliver advanced pumps, consistently meeting our customers' evolving demands.

Superior Quality

We adhere to strict quality control measures, ensuring that every product leaving our facility is built to perform in the most demanding environments.

Customer-Centric Approach

Our success is built on strong customer relationships. We work closely with our clients to understand their requirements.

Global Reach

We serve industries across the globe, providing solutions that are both reliable and cost-effective, making us a trusted name in rotary gear pumps.
